_comment: Canned responses for tunastreet.tminus under --fixture. Shape captured from the live backend (~/amoled-tminus/backend/server.py, Launch Library 2 upcoming window) and frozen so a check run is reproducible: a Falcon 9 Starlink launch, card 1 of 8, t0 fixed relative to server_unix so the countdown is always the same T-. tminus steps SERVER-side (POST /tminus/step returns the new card), so a static fixture cannot change idx -- selftest.js asserts on how many step requests a drag issues, not on the rendered index. `img` (#222) is the device-facing vehicle-art route, or null on a clean miss (no generated art for that vehicle yet) -- the first card here has art (falcon-9.jpg exists), the second exercises the miss path (no electron.jpg yet) so the harness drives both the download branch and the vector-art fallback branch.
